port.ask: Serial port the Alicat is cabled to (its USB cable, or the RS-232/RS-485 adapter)

unit_id.ask: Unit ID letter of this device (shown on its display under Setup > Comm; factory default A)
unit_id.help: One letter A to Z. On an RS-485 bus every device needs a different letter; the device answers only to its own.

baud.ask: Baud rate set on the device (Setup > Comm; factory default 19200)
